chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: Shooting craps on the bus with Billie
summary: Basie confirms Billie shot craps on the bus and that he played too, but will not say who won.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Did you ever see her shoot crap in a bus?
Did you ever see her shoot crap in a bus?
How was she? Was she good?
Who used to win most of the bread in craps? Who was the best?
I don't know. Don't look at me. It wasn't me.
You used to shoot with her?
Well, you ain't going to let her action go off without me getting in it, do you?
Did she lend musicians money? Did she have any to lend?
Did she have any money to lend at all? you could get
